title: Chusky has been upgraded
bullets: Added Muna for Monid research on qualified leads, enrichment, local prospects, company briefs, audiences, visibility, creators, video, and reviews. Findings include source links, verification, coverage, uncertainty, and spend controls.
Muna does not buy personal contact data, contact prospects, write CRM records, publish content, or create recurring monitoring; Monid remains disabled until configured and its terms are cleared.
The chat agent can diagnose an owned mission’s runtime health, including stale waits, active steps, worker leases, failures, budget pressure, and safe next actions, without changing mission state.
